context: The player has just taken a relic from a crypt in an abandoned chapel; when the artefact was lifted all the nearby candles sputtered out and something elsewhere in the building stirred. This comes after earlier looting in the chapel area — the party found a reliquary key and may have picked up an old prayer sheet that could relate to magically sealed chests. Shadowheart is present and confused about who the chapel was dedicated to, so the shrine’s patron and purpose remain unknown. The noises from an adjacent room imply a guardian, occupant, or other watcher has been alerted and is moving toward the party.
